# Diana Barry & Jane Andrews

- [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — Friend of — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) — friends and travelling companions · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P71](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0071), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P24](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P2](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

> Following her successful recitation and encore at the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is warmly praised by the guests, including a stout pink lady and Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for supper before they leave with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) in his carriage, chatting about wealth, compliments from an artist, and being content with who they are.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery Scholarship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, and she subsequently celebrates her success at commencement with her loved ones. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconnects with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and learns that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) plans to teach locally instead of attending [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She also notes signs of aging and ill health in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), enjoying a serene evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) in the pasture before hardship strikes.
>
